RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the April 28, 2008/Vaisakha 8, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Law
and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Women and Child
Development)
Total number of questions — 20
153
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Women empowerment
†*481. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of WOMEN
AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a report
prepared recently by London School of
Oriental & African Studies, has indicated
about the negligence towards and poor
condition of women;
(b) if so, whether the so called women
empowerment is proving to be deceptive,
with half of the population of the country;
(c) if so, whether Government is
formulating any effective scheme to enable
women to get rid of these basic problems;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Enlistment of OBCs
*482. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL  JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal under
active consideration of the Central
Government to enlist Other Backward
Classes (OBCs), besides Scheduled Castes/
Scheduled Tribes;
(b) if so, whether there is a demand to
form a Third Schedule for OBCs and
Vimukti Jati and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT);
(c) if so, whether Government has
taken/proposes to take steps in view of
the said demand; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of Rural
Electrification Scheme
*483. SHRI HARISH RAWA T:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Central Government has
recently asked the State Governments to
provide necessary support to expedite
implementation of the Rural Electrification
Scheme;

154
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether some State Governments
are not implementing the Scheme in an
effective way, as a result of which people
in rural areas are facing problems; and
(d) if so, the steps contemplated by
Government to ensure proper
implementation  of the Scheme across the
country?
Purchase of additional power during
peak hours
†*484. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that additional
power during the peak hours is being
purchased by various States of the country
at the rate of seven rupees per unit;
(b) if not, the facts in that regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that this
power is generally sold at the rate of
Rs. 2.50 to Rs. 3.50 per unit;
(d) if not, the facts in that regard;
(e) whether the average cost of power
generation in the country is less than its
sale price; and
(f) if so, what is the average cost of
power generation?
IIIT and IIITA in Gujarat
*485. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Planning Commission
has recommended the setting up of the
Indian Institute of Information Technology
(IIIT) and the Indian Institute of
Information Technology Academy (IIITA)
in Gujarat;
(b) if so, by when these institutes would
be established; and
(c) what would be the contribution of
the State and the Central Government for
these institutes?
Policy for minimum use of renewable
energy
*486. SHRI T.T.V . DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of NEW AND
RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is no
policy for compulsory use of minimum
quantity of renewable energy;
(b) if so, whether Government proposes
to frame such a policy;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Expenditure on higher education
*487. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the share of
the Central Government in investment/
expenditure on higher education is
abysmally low, i.e. less than one per cent
of the total investment/expenditure;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last five years and the reasons therefor;
and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken by
the Central Government in this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Projects for generation of solar
energy
*488. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of NEW AND
RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the projects for
generation of solar energy in the country,
State-wise;
(b) the volume of energy generated from
this source during the last three years, year-
wise;
(c) whether the Ministry has any plans
to increase the generation; and
(d) if so, the details of the plans for
enhancing the generation of solar energy?

of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:

implement the 27 per cent reservation for
